"""Read the actual discrete connections and query connectivity and relative-resistance paths. This analysis performs no history-matching parameter optimization."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix
from scipy.sparse.csgraph import connected_components,dijkstra
from spatial_tools import native_fields
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
indices,xyz,wells=native_fields()
neighbors=np.fromfile(ROOT/"topology/neighbors.bin",dtype=np.int64).reshape((2,-1),order="F")-1
t=np.fromfile(ROOT/"topology/transmissibility.bin")
assert np.isfinite(t).all() and np.all(t>=0)
positive=t>0
reference=float(np.median(t[positive]))
n=len(indices)
rows,cols=neighbors[:,positive]
weights=reference/t[positive]
graph=coo_matrix((np.r_[weights,weights],(np.r_[rows,cols],np.r_[cols,rows])),shape=(n,n)).tocsr()
count,labels=connected_components(graph,directed=False)
report={"active_cells":n,"discrete_connections":len(t),"zero_transmissibility_connections":int((~positive).sum()),"positive_transmissibility_component_count":count,
    "path_notes":"A static minimum-resistance path uses reciprocal transmissibility as its cost. It is a spatial query that omits evolving pressure differences, relative permeability and wellbore mixing. It does not measure a tracer path or breakthrough time.",
    "well_connection_components":{},"injector_to_producer_relative_resistance_paths":{}}
for well,d in wells.groupby("well"):
    ids=d.active_index.to_numpy()-1
    labs,counts=np.unique(labels[ids],return_counts=True)
    report["well_connection_components"][well]={str(i):int(c) for i,c in zip(labs,counts)}
paths={}
for injector in ["I11-W","I12-W","I13-W","I14-W","I15-W","I17-W"]:
    seeds=wells[wells.well==injector].active_index.to_numpy()-1
    distance,predecessors,sources=dijkstra(graph,directed=False,indices=seeds,min_only=True,return_predecessors=True)
    for producer in ["P11","P12","P13","P14","P15","P16"]:
        ends=wells[wells.well==producer].active_index.to_numpy()-1
        end=int(ends[np.argmin(distance[ends])])
        if not np.isfinite(distance[end]):continue
        path=[end]
        while predecessors[path[-1]]>=0:
            path.append(int(predecessors[path[-1]]))
            if len(path)>n:raise ValueError("Cycle detected in the path")
        path=np.array(path[::-1])
        name=injector+"__"+producer
        paths[name]=path
        report["injector_to_producer_relative_resistance_paths"][name]={"relative_resistance":float(distance[end]),"path_cell_count":len(path),
            "shallowest_depth":float(xyz[2,path].min()),"deepest_depth":float(xyz[2,path].max())}
(ROOT/"topology/analysis.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
np.savez_compressed(ROOT/"topology/paths.npz",**paths)
print({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in {"injector_to_producer_relative_resistance_paths","well_connection_components"}})
for producer in ["P11","P12","P13","P14","P15","P16"]:
    matches=[(k,v) for k,v in report["injector_to_producer_relative_resistance_paths"].items() if k.endswith("__"+producer)]
    print(producer,sorted(matches,key=lambda item:item[1]["relative_resistance"])[:2])
